name: us3-mandatory-field-refusal
description: T085/T096a/T081a: a project whose parent type declares required custom fields the bridge cannot supply. Run 1 (--dry-run) predicts the surviving refusal unchanged (contract §4.3 — the preview never asks). Run 2, a plain invocation with nothing recorded, now stops for the consolidated question instead of refusing outright (011, contract §3.3's second trigger: a required field is unsatisfiable and the operator is reachable) — the fixture's defaultable_fields (research R3) makes the field-level detail available. Run 3 declares the operator unreachable with --accept-defaults, carrying the refusal this scenario was named for: naming every unsatisfiable field of every written type in one message, no read, no write, byte-identical on both ports (contracts/hierarchy-resolution.md §5, 011 contract §3.6).
